i_bearskin.lore.common: Tickles the nose of every guard standing next to it, and none of them are allowed to sneeze.

x_cardigan_sweater.lore.common: Gets its sleeve caught on every door handle, then unravels a little bit more each time.

x_cloak.lore.common: Drags its hem through every puddle, so it comes home heavier than it left.

x_ice_skate.lore.rare: Carved a perfect figure of eight into the ice so deep that the ice-smoothing machine had to go round it twice.

x_pump_shoe.lore.common: Pinches your little toe after the first dance, then refuses to come off when your feet swell.

x_tank_top.lore.rare: Let its wearer flex their arms at the beach so proudly that the lifeguard flexed back.

x_wedge_shoe.lore.epic: Danced on the wooden deck at the summer wedding until every board squeaked along in tune.

i_theater_curtain.lore.legendary: Upstaged the lead actor by closing on him mid-song. The audience loved it, and the curtain now has its own dressing room.

i_velvet.names.legendary: Lady Plushwell of the Drawing Room

x_robe.lore.uncommon: Always has one cold teabag in its pocket, and it turns up again after every wash.
